messages:
Marta: quick after-action thread from the postmortem. we need owners for: headroom targets, autoscale tuning, quota backstops, and a recurring audit. short replies pls.
Ravi: i'll take autoscale/scheduler knobs. short-term: feature-flag slot_boost for small models (8->11). PR ETA 2025-06-11.
Elena: i'll own quota backstops. plan: per-tenant token bucket + emergency throttle; PR ETA 2025-06-09.
Marta: i'll draft headroom targets + routing rules to Dedicated pools. due 2025-06-13. will include cost impact.
hm-bot: incident summary: 2025-06-02 02:10 UTC surge -> scheduler queue growth and headroom starvation; peak GPU util 98.2%; fallback_rate 20%.
Ravi: canary plan: 3% traffic for 2h, monitor gpu_utilization, scheduler_queue_len, preemption_rate, fallback_rate. smoke test: 10m at 80% sustained + 30m soak at 70%.
Elena: quota example:
```yaml
per_tenant:
  burst_tokens: 320
  refill_per_sec: 32
  max_concurrent: 140
alerts:
  sustained_pct: 68
```
Marta: recurring pattern: headroom erosion every ~21 days tied to batch windows. propose weekly headroom audit in ops rotation. opsbot, can you create that?
opsbot: created task #CI-5600 "weekly-headroom-audit" assigned ops-rotation; first run 2025-06-14.
Ravi: opened draft PR for slot_boost: https://git.internal/r/4901 - requesting review from @Elena @Marta.
Elena: PR for token-bucket opened: https://git.internal/r/4902 - will enable alerts 24h after merge.
Marta: owners + due dates recap:
- Ravi: scheduler slot_boost PR + canary plan - due 2025-06-11
- Elena: quota token-bucket PR + alerts - due 2025-06-09
- Marta: headroom + routing proposal - due 2025-06-13
Marta: after merges we'll run a 2h canary verification and 6h soak for full rollouts. please paste PR links here when ready. closing for now, reopen if blockers. :thumbsup:
